ResearchTrace.verificationSummary: Cleared research logs, assistant residues, internal paths, writing instructions, and all five categories of editorial tone. Previous round issues RT-1 (wiki notes calculation narration), RT-2 (table row self-reference), RT-3 (table row self-reference), and RT-4 (external write-up narration) were completely resolved. Legitimate descriptive source links (Farmhouse, Version History, Carpenter's Shop, Marriage, Mermaid's Pendant, Cabin) and operational conditions are preserved without editorial commentary.

ReaderValue.verificationSummary: Aligned with user keyword 'house upgrade stardew' and task card. Tested all four core reader scenarios: 1) Purchasing next tier across tiers 1, 2, and 3; 2) Ordering during normal operating hours (9:00am-5:00pm, Tue closed, Fri 4:00pm close, 9:00am-8:00pm door vs counter distinction) and 3-day clock contrast; 3) Purchasing 450 wood from Robin in Year 1 (14,500g total) vs Year 2+ (32,500g total) with sell-price non-increase; 4) Instant refundable renovations vs 3-day Tier 3 upgrade with Remove Crib (free) and Add Dining Room (150,000g, 9x10+4x5 unoccupied refund condition). Figure roles (tier-rooms for spatial stage progression, upgrade-or-renovation for decision branching) cleanly separated from prose and table data. Single task completed without multi-intent encyclopedia drift.

Repetition.verificationSummary: Full-text comparative review across all paragraphs, tables, and media captions. Previous round issues RP-1 (redundant wood cost summary paragraph), RP-2 (redundant exterior statement in renovation section), and RP-3 (redundant list of unlocked rooms in construction wait paragraph) were cleanly eliminated. Each paragraph, table row, and caption serves a distinct non-duplicative communicative role. No duplicate FAQ or wrap-up modules.
